biotools.summary: RSVrecon is a bioinformatics pipeline for comprehensive RSV genome assembly and phylogenetic analysis, processing raw FASTQ files into annotated variant reports in multiple formats. It enhances RSV surveillance by detecting genotypes and clinically relevant mutations.
